g_g_1.summary: Belgium's aging but quality golden generation proves too strong for Egypt, with De Bruyne orchestrating a comfortable victory.

g_g_2.summary: Iran's disciplined defensive structure and set-piece threat edges out a physical but limited New Zealand side.

g_g_3.summary: Belgium's superior squad quality and attacking depth dismantles Iran's defensive block with clinical finishing.

g_g_4.summary: A hard-fought draw between two evenly matched sides, with New Zealand's physicality canceling out Egypt's technical play.

g_g_5.summary: Belgium wraps up group stage with a routine win over New Zealand, rotating some players but still showing clear class advantage.

g_g_6.summary: Egypt secures second place with a narrow victory over Iran, with Salah's influence proving decisive in a tense encounter.

g_f_1.summary: Netherlands' superior squad depth and physicality edges out a disciplined Japan side in a tight opener.

g_f_2.summary: Sweden's organized structure and physical presence proves too much for a defensively stubborn but limited Tunisia.

g_f_3.summary: Netherlands' attacking quality through their golden generation remnants secures a crucial three points against a well-organized Sweden.

g_f_4.summary: Japan's technical precision and disciplined pressing dismantles Tunisia's defensive setup to claim a vital victory.

g_f_5.summary: Netherlands comfortably dispatch an already-eliminated Tunisia with their attacking firepower on full display.

g_f_6.summary: Japan's high-energy pressing and clinical finishing earns a dramatic win over Sweden to secure second place in the group.

g_i_1.summary: France's superior squad depth and Mbappé's individual brilliance edge out a resilient Senegal side in a competitive opener.

g_i_2.summary: Haaland leads Norway to a comfortable victory over Iraq, whose defensive frailties are exposed by Norway's direct, physical attacking play.

g_i_3.summary: France's world-class midfield and clinical finishing prove too much for Norway despite Haaland's lone goal keeping the match tense until late.

g_i_4.summary: Senegal's pace, physicality, and African championship pedigree overwhelm an outclassed Iraq side in a dominant group stage performance.

g_i_5.summary: France rotate but still have too much quality for Iraq, with their attacking depth ensuring a comfortable win to seal top spot in Group I.

g_i_6.summary: A hard-fought draw sees both Senegal and Norway secure enough points to advance, with Haaland's equalizer canceling out Senegal's first-half lead.

g_k_1.summary: Portugal's deep squad and world-class attacking talent prove too much for a physically capable but tactically limited DR Congo side.

g_k_2.summary: Colombia's technical quality and experienced midfield control the game against an improving but outclassed Uzbekistan.

g_k_3.summary: Portugal's superior squad depth and individual brilliance comfortably dispatch a disciplined but limited Uzbekistan outfit.

g_k_4.summary: Colombia edge a physical and chaotic contest against DR Congo thanks to their superior technical quality and composure in front of goal.

g_k_5.summary: Portugal secure top spot in Group K with a hard-fought win over Colombia, with Ronaldo's leadership and clinical finishing proving decisive.

g_k_6.summary: DR Congo's physicality and set-piece threat earn them a narrow victory over Uzbekistan, but both sides are eliminated from the tournament.

g_j_1.summary: Defending champions Argentina assert dominance with clinical finishing against a disciplined but outclassed Algerian side.

g_j_2.summary: Austria's superior squad depth and European pedigree prove too much for a disciplined but limited Jordanian outfit.

g_j_3.summary: Argentina's world-class attacking talent edges out a competitive Austria side that makes them work hard for the win.

g_j_4.summary: A tightly contested match between two evenly matched sides ends in a share of the points, with both needing a result.

g_j_5.summary: Argentina cruise to a comfortable victory over Jordan, with their attacking trio proving far too potent for the Jordanian defense.

g_j_6.summary: Austria secure second place in the group with a hard-fought win over Algeria, whose early exit is confirmed despite a spirited showing.

g_d_1.summary: USA leverages home-crowd advantage and superior squad depth to edge a defensively stubborn Paraguay side.

g_d_2.summary: Turkey's rising tactical quality and physical intensity prove too much for a resilient but outgunned Australia.

g_d_3.summary: USA's growing Premier League and European-based talent dominates an Australia side missing the cutting edge to trouble a well-organized American defense.

g_d_4.summary: Paraguay's disciplined counter-attacking system neutralizes Turkey's attacking threat, earning a hard-fought point in a tight tactical battle.

g_d_5.summary: USA clinches group leadership with a confident home performance, their superior squad depth and pressing game wearing down a competitive Turkey.

g_d_6.summary: Paraguay secures second place with a narrow win over Australia, their defensive solidity and set-piece threat proving decisive in a low-quality encounter.

g_l_1.summary: England's superior squad depth and attacking firepower overwhelm an aging Croatian side that has lost its midfield dominance.

g_l_2.summary: Ghana's athleticism and unpredictable attacking play prove too much for a defensively-minded Panama side.

g_l_3.summary: England's star-studded attack dismantles Ghana's high defensive line with clinical finishing and individual brilliance.

g_l_4.summary: Croatia's experienced midfield controls the tempo and creates enough quality chances to comfortably beat a limited Panama side.

g_l_5.summary: England cruise to a routine victory against a Panama side that offers little going forward and cannot cope with England's pace on the break.

g_l_6.summary: A tense and evenly-matched final group game ends in a draw as Croatia's tactical discipline cancels out Ghana's energetic pressing game.

g_b_1.summary: Two well-organized, defensively solid sides cancel each other out in a tight opener, with Canada's home support unable to break Swiss resilience.

g_b_2.summary: Bosnia's talented individuals prove too much for a Qatar side still developing at the top level, with BIH's attacking quality making the difference.

g_b_3.summary: Canada's pace, physicality, and home crowd advantage overwhelm a limited Qatar side in a dominant display that boosts their goal difference.

g_b_4.summary: Switzerland's tactical discipline and clinical finishing edge out Bosnia in a closely contested match where Swiss organization proves decisive.

g_b_5.summary: Canada secure top spot with a hard-fought win over Bosnia, their home advantage and growing tournament momentum proving the key factor.

g_b_6.summary: Switzerland comfortably dispatch Qatar to confirm second place, their superior squad depth and tactical structure never seriously threatened.

g_a_1.summary: Mexico, playing with strong home support in North America, controls possession and converts two set-piece opportunities against a limited South African side.

g_a_2.summary: A technically even contest ends level as Korea's high-energy pressing is neutralized by Czechia's disciplined defensive structure and clinical counter-attack.

g_a_3.summary: Mexico's home-crowd advantage and experienced attackers prove decisive, though Korea's relentless pressing makes it a competitive affair until the final whistle.

g_a_4.summary: Czechia's technical quality and composure in front of goal prove too much for South Africa, who grab a consolation but ultimately fall short.

g_a_5.summary: Mexico secures top spot with a hard-fought win, as their attacking depth and home support overcome a stubborn Czech side that creates chances but lacks finishing.

g_a_6.summary: Korea's superior athleticism and tactical discipline earn a crucial victory to secure second place, with South Africa's tournament ending despite a spirited late goal.

g_c_1.summary: Brazil's attacking wealth edges Morocco in a tight opener, with Morocco's defensive solidity keeping it close until a late Brazilian winner.

g_c_2.summary: Scotland's organization and set-piece threat prove too much for Haiti, who struggle to contain the physical Scottish midfield.

g_c_3.summary: Brazil's world-class attacking talent runs riot against a limited Haitian side with no answer to the South American flair and pace.

g_c_4.summary: Morocco's defensive discipline and clinical counter-attacking edge out Scotland, who create chances but lack the finishing quality to break through.

g_c_5.summary: Brazil's individual brilliance is the difference as Scotland defend valiantly but ultimately cannot contain the South American attacking threat.

g_c_6.summary: Morocco comfortably dispatch Haiti with a dominant display, securing second place in the group with a convincing clean sheet victory.

g_e_1.summary: Germany's superior squad depth and tactical organization overwhelm a limited Curaçao side with no realistic path to containing their attacking firepower.

g_e_2.summary: Two evenly matched Tier 3 sides cancel each other out in a physical, competitive opener with Ecuador's high-pressing style neutralizing Ivory Coast's individual quality.

g_e_3.summary: Germany's tactical discipline and midfield control shut down Ivory Coast's attacking threats while clinical finishing secures a comfortable victory.

g_e_4.summary: Ecuador's energetic pressing and youthful attacking talent prove far too much for Curaçao, who struggle to create any meaningful chances throughout the match.

g_e_5.summary: Germany edge a competitive match against an improving Ecuador side, with their experience and quality in the final third proving the decisive difference.

g_e_6.summary: Ivory Coast's physical presence and individual class are too much for Curaçao, who exit the tournament without a point as the African side secures second place.

g_h_1.summary: Spain's possession-based system and technical superiority overwhelm a limited Cape Verde side with no answer to the Spanish press.

g_h_2.summary: Uruguay's defensive grit and clinical finishing from their experienced forwards prove too much for an improving but outclassed Saudi Arabia.

g_h_3.summary: Spain control the tempo and exploit spaces behind Saudi Arabia's high defensive line with incisive combination play.

g_h_4.summary: Uruguay's physical intensity and attacking quality are far too strong for Cape Verde, who struggle to contain the South American press.

g_h_5.summary: Uruguay's defensive organization frustrates Spain for long stretches, and both sides settle for a draw that suits them both having already qualified.

g_h_6.summary: Both eliminated sides play for pride in an evenly contested match, with neither able to find a decisive winner in a scrappy encounter.

m73.summary: Switzerland's superior organization and tournament experience edge out a technically solid Czech side in a tight, low-scoring affair.

m76.summary: Brazil's attacking brilliance and physical superiority overwhelm a technically gifted but outmatched Japan side in a commanding performance.

m80.summary: England's star-studded squad controls the match with superior technical quality, shutting down Ivory Coast's physical attacking threat.

m82.summary: Belgium's golden-generation quality and clinical finishing prove just enough to overcome a dangerous Norway side powered by Haaland, who grabs a consolation goal.

m83.summary: Colombia's youthful attacking talent and pace on the counter unsettles an aging Croatian midfield, securing a narrow but deserved victory.

m84.summary: Spain's possession-based dominance and technical superiority suffocate Austria, with their pressing game creating enough chances to win comfortably.

m85.summary: Canada, buoyed by host-nation support and a strong group stage, edge out Norway despite Haaland's threat, with their collective pressing game proving decisive on home soil.

m88.summary: A tight, tactical affair between two defensively solid sides ends level after 90 minutes, with Turkey's greater squad depth eventually telling as they advance 4-2 on penalties.

m90.summary: Switzerland's disciplined defensive block frustrates the Netherlands for long stretches, but Dutch individual quality and attacking creativity eventually break through for a narrow but deserved victory.

m91.summary: Brazil's attacking wealth and technical superiority prove too much for a spirited Senegal side, with the Seleção controlling possession and converting their chances with clinical efficiency.

m92.summary: Despite Mexico's passionate home support creating a hostile atmosphere, England's star-studded squad and superior technical quality prove the difference in a tense, competitive encounter.

m93.summary: Spain's possession mastery and technical superiority gradually wear down Colombia's energetic pressing, with their young talent creating enough quality chances to advance despite a spirited Colombian fightback.

m94.summary: USA's host-nation momentum and relentless pressing on home soil prove decisive against an aging Belgian golden generation that struggles to contain the Americans' pace and energy in the final third.

m95.summary: Argentina's defending-champion pedigree and individual brilliance prove far too much for a defensively resolute Egypt side that ultimately cannot contain the South American giants' attacking quality.

m96.summary: Portugal's deep squad and clinical finishing edge out a spirited Canada side buoyed by home support, with the Selecção's superior individual quality ultimately proving the difference in a competitive tie.

m97.summary: France's superior squad depth and Mbappé's individual brilliance prove the decisive factor against a resilient Netherlands side that competes hard but ultimately cannot match the French attacking quality over 90 minutes.

m98.summary: Spain's possession mastery and technical precision gradually suffocate USA's high-energy pressing game, with their young talent creating enough quality chances to advance despite the Americans' passionate home support pushing them hard.

m99.summary: A tightly contested heavyweight clash sees Brazil and England cancel each other out over 90 minutes before Brazil's individual flair and attacking creativity edge a tense extra-time period to advance 3-1 on penalties.

m100.summary: Argentina's defending-champion mentality and collective brilliance prove the difference in a compelling South American versus European clash, with their tournament experience and squad cohesion edging out a dangerous Portugal side in a closely fought contest.

m101.summary: France's attacking firepower led by Mbappé ultimately proves too much for Spain's possession-based system, with the French clinical on the counter-attack after a tightly contested first half that Spain dominated territorially.

m102.summary: A classic heavyweight encounter sees England and Argentina locked level after 90 minutes and extra time before Argentina's penalty shootout experience and composure as defending champions sees them edge through 4-3 on penalties.

m103.summary: Spain's technically superior midfield controls the tempo and their young talent proves too much for a physically and emotionally drained Argentina side coming off a grueling penalty shootout, with ESP securing third place through composed possession and clinical finishing.

m104.summary: France's relentless attacking trio of Mbappé, Dembélé, and Thuram overwhelms England's defense in a pulsating final, with France securing their third World Cup title through clinical finishing and tactical discipline despite a spirited English fightback.
